title: Listening party: Venus And Mars by Wings | 1975
content:
The second of two listening parties for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars was held on 20 May 1975.

The event was hosted by the band’s US publicist Dennis Fine at Capitol Records’ New York offices, and was attended by members of the US press corps. It followed a similar event in London on 12 May.
